evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically from ~8 ppm to 30.8 ppm during growth
Tube pressure creeping up 3.04 → 3.27 Torr at constant Ar flow 100 sccm
MFC steady at setpoint, so pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control fine

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, or a leak-check: briefly reduce/stop Ar flow and watch pressure rise rate and O2 response (leak vs. exhaust restriction).
